selectionDefinition.connection: a tracking-derived change between distinct same-team source-labelled owners; every departure/arrival actor is directly observed for a 0.5 s guard on each side and the ball remains continuously recorded
selectionDefinition.claims: tracking-derived geometric descriptions only; no pass, goal, optimal-choice, body, foot, scan, or ball-height event is inferred

themeThresholds.pressureSupport: nearest observed opposing player at the ownership anchor is at most 6 m away, the recorded ball connection is at least 4 m, and the connection is less than 10 m forward; no approach or closing speed is inferred
themeThresholds.combination: three directly observed same-team ownership segments within 8 s with at least 5 m of recorded ball displacement on each leg; the first and third may be the same player in a return link

selectionDefinition.visibilityGuarantees: core, one off-ball support actor, and relevant opponents stay directly observed through the central sequence after impossible-speed filtering; meaningful source-labelled owner runs are visible throughout
selectionDefinition.missingData: missing coordinates use a non-pitch sentinel plus visibility=0; no (0,0), carry-forward, interpolation, or display reconstruction is shipped
